fields.title: 📖 Ibn Qutaybah: Ahl al-Ḥadīth preserve the transmission
fields.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Qutaybah** said:

> ***“Ibn Qutaybah defended Ahl al-Ḥadīth and explained that they carry and preserve the transmissions of the Messenger ﷺ.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever belittles Ahl al-Ḥadīth weakens the bridge to the Sunnah. Transmission is a protection of the Dīn.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn Qutaybah, Taʾwīl Mukhtalif al-Ḥadīth, Einleitung zur Verteidigung der Hadithleute.
